author: Sharon Williamson
text: We recently had our septic tank pumped, and the service was outstanding.  Nathan and his team were very respectful and professional. They were able to address all my questions and concerns.  Very affordable price as well!  I highly recommend!  😊

author: Deb E
text:
Fantastic experience!! Nathan and Company are amazing!! They came out same day, pumped our septic system, checked everything and answered any questions we had. Would highly recommend them for any septic work.

author: Kyle Dean
text:
I can’t recommend Richard Barrett Septic enough! Nathan Bray and his team are absolutely top-notch. From start to finish, the entire experience was smooth, professional, and stress-free. Nathan is incredibly knowledgeable, honest, and takes the time to explain everything clearly so you feel confident in the work being done.
They showed up on time, worked efficiently, and went above and beyond to make sure everything was done right. It’s rare these days to find a company that truly cares about its customers, but this team definitely does.
If you’re looking for reliable, high-quality septic service, this is the company to call. Highly recommended!

author: Ivan Ingermann
text: Nathan came out and gave me a straight forward evaluation of my septic issues, which turned out less than expected. He easily could have stretched the truth and gone for the gold! Now,  I trust this company. Highly recommended!
